from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Map the dominant input color to the other color and the other to 0."""
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    dominant = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other = next(color for color in counts if color != dominant)
    return [[other if cell == dominant else 0 for cell in row] for row in grid]
